project: Engenharia Reversa — REA original Linux VPS
covered_behaviors: Cancelled Evidence export does not publish partial output in original MCP in-memory session, with and without overwrite.
Cancelled Evidence import leaves complete original Evidence/Unknown state unchanged and permits valid retry.
Failed file-close error remains in owning server scope; subsequent retry can be evaluated.
Transient import file-close failure is retried before accepting bundle.
get_evidence_bundle returns complete retained Evidence body.
Original MCP rejects structurally unsupported Evidence bundle metadata while retaining existing Evidence unchanged.
limitations: Seven native tests run only via original staged REA source in isolated in-memory MCP; no live permanent functional tool certification.
Tests do not prove durability of permanent service after process crash or guarantee the original six P214 restored Evidence across restart.
The source checkout commit is pinned to 8e9a7ee; P242 proved 10 critical installed and staged file SHA parity, not entire binary/source parity.
Full 208/208 requires individual original MCP tools/call functional evidence; workspace scoped owner authorization and sensitive fresh Ed25519 signatures cannot be invented or bypassed.
